content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

This infrastructure empowers you to bypass the limitations of conventional payment systems. Platforms like Stripe often exclude creators in developing regions, leaving them without reliable income streams. By leveraging NOWPayments, you gain access to over 300 cryptocurrencies, with transaction fees as low as 0.5%. This ensures that you maintain full control over your digital products and revenue, eliminating the vulnerability of relying on third-party platforms that may impose restrictions or delays.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your NOWPayments digital store, ensure you have essential tools and accounts set up. You'll need a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting your store, a Google account for managing your order data, and a NOWPayments account for payment processing. Additionally, familiarize yourself with crypto wallets to store your earnings securely. This preparation lays the foundation for a seamless deployment, allowing you to focus on selling your digital products without unnecessary delays.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To establish your payment and delivery pipeline, start by integrating NOWPayments into your platform. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your storefront. Next, configure Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, enabling automatic payment verification and product delivery. Store your product orders in Supabase or Google Sheets, which allows easy access and management of your sales data. With this setup, you ensure that your customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation.
Experience instant payments with USDT on the Tron network—costing under $0.10 per transaction.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Promote your digital products through social media or email marketing, directing traffic to your store. As orders start coming in, monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for transaction confirmations. Payments made with USDT on the Tron network typically cost under $0.10, making it an economical choice for your customers. Ensure you test the entire process from payment to product delivery to identify and rectify any potential issues.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing initial transactions, focus on scaling your digital store. Use the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates to enhance your store's functionality. Expand your product offerings, optimize your marketing strategies, and analyze customer feedback to refine your approach. By continuously improving your infrastructure, you can increase sales and strengthen your brand's presence in the market.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

To receive crypto payments for your digital products, set up a NOWPayments account and integrate it with your storefront. Transactions are processed automatically, enabling you to receive payments directly to your wallet. This system is faster than PayPal, especially with USDT payments on the Tron network, which confirm in minutes rather than days.
No subscriptions, no dependencies—own your infrastructure outright.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those looking to deepen their understanding and capabilities, consider exploring the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which combines comprehensive blueprints and templates for a complete deployment. This resource is invaluable for optimizing your NOWPayments digital store. Check out additional insights at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
